boundary_note: Neisse 23 February–1 June; conditional handover on 16 June kept separate. Tactical and campaign replacement boundaries are unset; phases are research hypotheses. No feature admission or historical rating fit.

claims.value: Bodart: side A 6,000 under Vandamme; side B 6,100 and 344 guns under Steensen.
claims.rationale: Read on the registered page image. His general rule is forces disposable for the engagement, rounded upward (shared research-conventions index); a stated siege endpoint or engaged subset takes precedence over treating it as an opening count. Population/timing alternatives are not reconciled. English rendering (ours): "The French, Württemberg and Saxon troops (6,000 men) under Division-General Vandamme force the Prussian garrison (6,100 men, 344 guns) under Lieutenant-General von Steensen to capitulate, with handover on 16 June unless relieved. On 16 June 1807 the garrison, still 4,100 strong including 133 officers, marched out with full military honours and laid down its arms. Officers could return home on an undertaking not to serve against France or its allies in this war."

citations.quote: Die Franzosen, Württemberger und Sachsen (6.000 M.) unter Div.-Gen. Vandamme nötigen die preußische Besatzung (6.100 M. mit 344 Geschützen) unter Gen.-Lt. v. Steensen zur Kapitulation, wonach die Festung, falls bis zum 16. Juni d. J. kein Entsatz stattfände, am genannten Tage übergeben werden solle. Am 16. Juni 1807 marschierte die Besatzung (noch 4.100 M., wor. 133 Offz., stark) mit allen militärischen Ehren aus und streckte die Waffen. Den Offizieren wurde gegen ehrenwörtliche Verpflichtung, in diesem Kriege nicht gegen Frankreich oder dessen Bundesgenossen zu dienen, die Rückkehr in ihre Heimat bewilligt.

claims.value: Höpfner’s opening establishment totals 6,124 men against a required full armament of 12,000; 280 civilians clearing ditch ice are listed separately.
claims.rationale: Civilian workers are not silently added to combat strength. English rendering (ours): "total 6,124 men instead of the 12,000 required for full armament of the place." English rendering (ours): "In addition there were 280 country people in the fortress to break the ditch ice."

citations.quote: zusammen 6124 Mann statt 12,000 Mann, die zur vollständigen Armirung des Platzes gehörten.
Außerdem befanden sich noch in der Festung 280 Landleute zum Aufeisen der Gräben.

claims.value: The Prussian government estimated the enemy at 5–6,000, including 1,000–1,500 cavalry.
claims.rationale: Defender’s estimate, not a French own return; Bodart’s 6,000 is not independently validated by similar rounding. English rendering (ours): "In the government’s opinion the enemy forces consisted of only 5–6,000 men, including 1,000–1,500 cavalry"

citations.quote: Nach der Ansicht des Gouvernements bestanden die feindlichen Streitkräfte nur aus 5—6000 Mann, worunter 1000 bis 1500 Mann Kavallerie

claims.value: Steensen was governor, Weger commandant with special authority in Fort Preussen; Bernitz directed artillery, Schultz II engineering under Harroy.
claims.rationale: Other staff roles are printed in the intervening list on this page; no allocation of equal command credit. English rendering (ours): "Governor of Neisse was the 71-year-old Lieutenant-General Steensen; commandant was the 68-year-old Major-General Weger" English rendering (ours): "The commandant held special command in Fort Preussen and the associated works" English rendering (ours): "Artillery officer of the place was the 66-year-old Colonel Bernitz; engineer of the place Captain Schultz II under Brigadier Major Harroy."

citations.quote: Gouverneur von Neiße war der 71 Jahre alte General-Lieutenant Steensen, Kommandant der 68jährige General-Major Weger
Der Kommandant befehligte speziell im Fort Preußen und den zugehörigen Werken
Artillerie-Offizier vom Platz der 66 Jahre alte Oberst Bernitz, Ingenieur vom Platz der Hauptmann Schultz II. unter dem Brigadier Major Harroy.

claims.value: Höpfner identifies Vandamme as the French general dealing with the fortress during the armistice and handover.
claims.rationale: This confirms a late administrative role; opening on-site delegation and superior instructions remain unknown. English rendering (ours): "so that General Vandamme during the armistice twice sent medicine and wine to the fortress out of pity."

citations.quote: so daß der General Vandamme während des Waffenstillstandes aus Mitleid zweimal Lieferungen an Arznei und Wein nach der Festung sandte.

claims.value: On 1 June Höpfner gives about 1,100 available for the town envelope, 1,200 for Fort Preussen/redoubts and 1,700 for the extensive retrenchments.
claims.rationale: Late allocations, not initial strength or independently calculated losses. English rendering (ours): "only about 1,100 men available for the town envelope, 1,200 for Fort Preussen and the separate redoubts, and 1,700 for the extensive retrenchments"

citations.quote: nur noch etwa 1100 Mann für die Vertheidigung der Stadt-Enveloppe, 1200 Mann für die des Forts Preußen und der einzelnen Redouten, und 1700 M. für die des weitläuftigen Retranchements disponibel

claims.value: Opening provisions covered six months of bread/biscuit, nearly four of meat and three of vegetables/butter; late siege condition differed.
claims.rationale: The inspected continuation specifies meat and vegetables/butter; ration duration is not readiness. English rendering (ours): "The garrison was supplied with bread and biscuit for six months"

citations.quote: Mit Brod und Zwieback war die Besatzung auf 6 Monate

claims.value: Defence relied on fortifications, sluice flooding and watered ditches; by 1 June the attacked palisade was shot away.
claims.rationale: English rendering (ours): "The palisading of the attacked front had been shot to pieces" English rendering (ours): "the flooding and ditch watering effected through sluices"

citations.quote: Die Pallisadirung der angegriffenen Front war zerschossen
die mittelst Schleusen bewerkstelligte Inondation und Grabenbewässerung
